content: Curator paraphrase: MACD subtracts EMA26 from EMA12 of prices and uses an EMA9 signal line. Crossing above the signal is a bullish observation; crossing below is bearish. Range conditions can generate repeated false crossings. This supplement computes those closed observations and only confirms an already proposed direction; the hour horizon and exact market context are laboratory scope choices, not publisher validation or an independent profitable strategy.
